info: 氫氣通常由 H₂ 分子組成；水也含有氫元素。
use: 氫氣可用於燃料電池。
infoEn: Hydrogen gas usually consists of H₂ molecules. Water also contains the element hydrogen.
useEn: Hydrogen can be used in fuel cells.

info: 氦是密度很低的氣體，化學性質很不活潑。
use: 可用來填充氣球，也可用於低溫冷卻。
infoEn: Helium is a very low-density gas and is chemically unreactive.
useEn: It can fill balloons and provide cooling at very low temperatures.

info: 鋰的元素符號是 Li，原子序數是 3。
infoEn: Lithium has the symbol Li and atomic number 3.

info: 鈹的元素符號是 Be，原子序數是 4。
infoEn: Beryllium has the symbol Be and atomic number 4.

info: 硼的元素符號是 B，原子序數是 5。
infoEn: Boron has the symbol B and atomic number 5.

info: 石墨和金剛石都是碳的不同形態，性質卻很不同。
use: 鉛筆芯含有石墨；金剛石可用於切割工具。
infoEn: Graphite and diamond are different forms of carbon with very different properties.
useEn: Pencil leads contain graphite. Diamond can be used in cutting tools.

info: 氮氣通常由 N₂ 分子組成，約佔乾燥空氣體積的 78%。
use: 氮氣可作食品包裝的保護氣體。
infoEn: Nitrogen gas usually consists of N₂ molecules and makes up about 78% of dry air by volume.
useEn: Nitrogen can be used as a protective gas in food packaging.

info: 氧氣通常由 O₂ 分子組成，約佔乾燥空氣體積的 21%。
use: 氧氣參與呼吸作用，也能支持燃燒。
infoEn: Oxygen gas usually consists of O₂ molecules and makes up about 21% of dry air by volume.
useEn: Oxygen is involved in respiration and supports burning.

info: 氟的元素符號是 F，原子序數是 9。
infoEn: Fluorine has the symbol F and atomic number 9.

info: 氖的元素符號是 Ne，原子序數是 10。
infoEn: Neon has the symbol Ne and atomic number 10.

info: 鈉是一種活潑的金屬；食鹽含鈉元素，但食鹽的性質與鈉金屬不同。
use: 鈉的化合物氯化鈉，就是食鹽的主要成分。
infoEn: Sodium is a reactive metal. Table salt contains sodium, but its properties differ from those of sodium metal.
useEn: Sodium chloride, a sodium compound, is the main component of table salt.

info: 鎂是較輕的金屬；燃燒時會發出耀眼的白光。
use: 鎂可用於照明彈，也可製成輕巧的合金。
infoEn: Magnesium is a light metal that burns with a dazzling white light.
useEn: Magnesium can be used in flares and to make lightweight alloys.

info: 鋁是銀白色、較輕而有展性的金屬。
use: 可製成鋁箔和飲品罐；鋁合金可用於飛機。
infoEn: Aluminium is a silvery-white, light metal that can be pressed into thin sheets.
useEn: It can be made into foil and drinks cans. Aluminium alloys can be used in aircraft.

info: 矽的元素符號是 Si，原子序數是 14。
infoEn: Silicon has the symbol Si and atomic number 14.

info: 磷的元素符號是 P，原子序數是 15。
infoEn: Phosphorus has the symbol P and atomic number 15.

info: 常見的硫是黃色固體，屬於非金屬。
use: 可用來製造硫酸，也用於橡膠的硫化處理。
infoEn: The familiar form of sulfur is a yellow solid. Sulfur is a non-metal.
useEn: It can be used to make sulphuric acid and to vulcanise rubber.

info: 氯氣通常由 Cl₂ 分子組成，是黃綠色的有毒氣體。
use: 氯及一些含氯化合物可用於水的消毒。
infoEn: Chlorine gas usually consists of Cl₂ molecules. It is a yellow-green, toxic gas.
useEn: Chlorine and some chlorine compounds can be used to disinfect water.

info: 氬的元素符號是 Ar，原子序數是 18。
infoEn: Argon has the symbol Ar and atomic number 18.

info: 鉀是一種活潑的金屬；植物需要的是鉀元素，通常以化合物中的離子形式吸收。
use: 一些鉀的化合物可用作肥料。
infoEn: Potassium is a reactive metal. Plants need the element potassium, which they usually absorb as ions from compounds.
useEn: Some potassium compounds can be used as fertilisers.

info: 鈣是金屬元素；骨骼和牙齒中的鈣主要存在於化合物中。
use: 碳酸鈣存在於石灰石；含鈣化合物也用於建築材料。
infoEn: Calcium is a metal element. The calcium in bones and teeth is mainly present in compounds.
useEn: Calcium carbonate is found in limestone. Calcium compounds are also used in building materials.

info: 鈧的元素符號是 Sc，原子序數是 21。
infoEn: Scandium has the symbol Sc and atomic number 21.

info: 鈦的元素符號是 Ti，原子序數是 22。
infoEn: Titanium has the symbol Ti and atomic number 22.

info: 釩的元素符號是 V，原子序數是 23。
infoEn: Vanadium has the symbol V and atomic number 23.

info: 鉻的元素符號是 Cr，原子序數是 24。
infoEn: Chromium has the symbol Cr and atomic number 24.

info: 錳的元素符號是 Mn，原子序數是 25。
infoEn: Manganese has the symbol Mn and atomic number 25.

info: 鐵是灰色金屬，能被磁鐵吸引；在潮濕空氣中會生鏽。
use: 鐵是鋼的主要成分；鋼可用於建築和工具。
infoEn: Iron is a grey metal attracted to magnets. It rusts in moist air.
useEn: Iron is the main component of steel, which is used in buildings and tools.

info: 鈷的元素符號是 Co，原子序數是 27。
infoEn: Cobalt has the symbol Co and atomic number 27.

info: 鎳的元素符號是 Ni，原子序數是 28。
infoEn: Nickel has the symbol Ni and atomic number 28.

info: 銅是紅棕色金屬，容易導電和傳熱。
use: 可製成電線、水管和一些合金。
infoEn: Copper is a reddish-brown metal that conducts electricity and heat well.
useEn: It can be used to make electrical wires, water pipes and some alloys.

info: 鋅是銀白色金屬，表面可帶一點藍色。
use: 可在鋼鐵表面鍍鋅，幫助防鏽。
infoEn: Zinc is a silvery-white metal that may have a slightly blue appearance.
useEn: It can coat iron and steel to help prevent rusting.

info: 鎵的元素符號是 Ga，原子序數是 31。
infoEn: Gallium has the symbol Ga and atomic number 31.

info: 鍺的元素符號是 Ge，原子序數是 32。
infoEn: Germanium has the symbol Ge and atomic number 32.

info: 砷的元素符號是 As，原子序數是 33。
infoEn: Arsenic has the symbol As and atomic number 33.

info: 硒的元素符號是 Se，原子序數是 34。
infoEn: Selenium has the symbol Se and atomic number 34.

info: 溴的元素符號是 Br，原子序數是 35。
infoEn: Bromine has the symbol Br and atomic number 35.

info: 氪的元素符號是 Kr，原子序數是 36。
infoEn: Krypton has the symbol Kr and atomic number 36.

info: 銣的元素符號是 Rb，原子序數是 37。
infoEn: Rubidium has the symbol Rb and atomic number 37.

info: 鍶的元素符號是 Sr，原子序數是 38。
infoEn: Strontium has the symbol Sr and atomic number 38.

info: 釔的元素符號是 Y，原子序數是 39。
infoEn: Yttrium has the symbol Y and atomic number 39.

info: 鋯的元素符號是 Zr，原子序數是 40。
infoEn: Zirconium has the symbol Zr and atomic number 40.

info: 鈮的元素符號是 Nb，原子序數是 41。
infoEn: Niobium has the symbol Nb and atomic number 41.

info: 鉬的元素符號是 Mo，原子序數是 42。
infoEn: Molybdenum has the symbol Mo and atomic number 42.

info: 鎝的元素符號是 Tc，原子序數是 43。
infoEn: Technetium has the symbol Tc and atomic number 43.

info: 釕的元素符號是 Ru，原子序數是 44。
infoEn: Ruthenium has the symbol Ru and atomic number 44.

info: 銠的元素符號是 Rh，原子序數是 45。
infoEn: Rhodium has the symbol Rh and atomic number 45.

info: 鈀的元素符號是 Pd，原子序數是 46。
infoEn: Palladium has the symbol Pd and atomic number 46.

info: 銀有明亮的金屬光澤，導電性很好。
use: 可用於首飾、鏡面和電接點。
infoEn: Silver has a bright metallic shine and conducts electricity very well.
useEn: It can be used in jewellery, mirror coatings and electrical contacts.

info: 鎘的元素符號是 Cd，原子序數是 48。
infoEn: Cadmium has the symbol Cd and atomic number 48.

info: 銦的元素符號是 In，原子序數是 49。
infoEn: Indium has the symbol In and atomic number 49.

info: 錫是銀白色金屬；「錫罐」通常是在鋼片表面鍍錫。
use: 可用於金屬鍍層和焊料合金。
infoEn: Tin is a silvery-white metal. A tin can is usually made of steel coated with tin.
useEn: It can be used for metal coatings and solder alloys.

info: 銻的元素符號是 Sb，原子序數是 51。
infoEn: Antimony has the symbol Sb and atomic number 51.

info: 碲的元素符號是 Te，原子序數是 52。
infoEn: Tellurium has the symbol Te and atomic number 52.

info: 碘的元素符號是 I，原子序數是 53。
infoEn: Iodine has the symbol I and atomic number 53.

info: 氙的元素符號是 Xe，原子序數是 54。
infoEn: Xenon has the symbol Xe and atomic number 54.

info: 銫的元素符號是 Cs，原子序數是 55。
infoEn: Caesium has the symbol Cs and atomic number 55.

info: 鋇的元素符號是 Ba，原子序數是 56。
infoEn: Barium has the symbol Ba and atomic number 56.

info: 鑭的元素符號是 La，原子序數是 57。
infoEn: Lanthanum has the symbol La and atomic number 57.

info: 鈰的元素符號是 Ce，原子序數是 58。
infoEn: Cerium has the symbol Ce and atomic number 58.

info: 鐠的元素符號是 Pr，原子序數是 59。
infoEn: Praseodymium has the symbol Pr and atomic number 59.

info: 釹的元素符號是 Nd，原子序數是 60。
infoEn: Neodymium has the symbol Nd and atomic number 60.

info: 鉕的元素符號是 Pm，原子序數是 61。
infoEn: Promethium has the symbol Pm and atomic number 61.

info: 釤的元素符號是 Sm，原子序數是 62。
infoEn: Samarium has the symbol Sm and atomic number 62.

info: 銪的元素符號是 Eu，原子序數是 63。
infoEn: Europium has the symbol Eu and atomic number 63.

info: 釓的元素符號是 Gd，原子序數是 64。
infoEn: Gadolinium has the symbol Gd and atomic number 64.

info: 鋱的元素符號是 Tb，原子序數是 65。
infoEn: Terbium has the symbol Tb and atomic number 65.

info: 鏑的元素符號是 Dy，原子序數是 66。
infoEn: Dysprosium has the symbol Dy and atomic number 66.

info: 鈥的元素符號是 Ho，原子序數是 67。
infoEn: Holmium has the symbol Ho and atomic number 67.

info: 鉺的元素符號是 Er，原子序數是 68。
infoEn: Erbium has the symbol Er and atomic number 68.

info: 銩的元素符號是 Tm，原子序數是 69。
infoEn: Thulium has the symbol Tm and atomic number 69.

info: 鐿的元素符號是 Yb，原子序數是 70。
infoEn: Ytterbium has the symbol Yb and atomic number 70.

info: 鎦的元素符號是 Lu，原子序數是 71。
infoEn: Lutetium has the symbol Lu and atomic number 71.

info: 鉿的元素符號是 Hf，原子序數是 72。
infoEn: Hafnium has the symbol Hf and atomic number 72.

info: 鉭的元素符號是 Ta，原子序數是 73。
infoEn: Tantalum has the symbol Ta and atomic number 73.

info: 鎢的元素符號是 W，原子序數是 74。
infoEn: Tungsten has the symbol W and atomic number 74.

info: 錸的元素符號是 Re，原子序數是 75。
infoEn: Rhenium has the symbol Re and atomic number 75.

info: 鋨的元素符號是 Os，原子序數是 76。
infoEn: Osmium has the symbol Os and atomic number 76.

info: 銥的元素符號是 Ir，原子序數是 77。
infoEn: Iridium has the symbol Ir and atomic number 77.

info: 鉑的元素符號是 Pt，原子序數是 78。
infoEn: Platinum has the symbol Pt and atomic number 78.

info: 金呈金黃色，化學性質較不活潑，容易壓成薄片。
use: 可用於首飾、金箔和電子零件的接點。
infoEn: Gold is golden yellow, relatively unreactive and easily pressed into thin sheets.
useEn: It can be used in jewellery, gold leaf and electrical contacts in electronic parts.

info: 汞又稱水銀，是室溫下呈液態的金屬，有毒。
use: 過去常用於溫度計；如今許多用途已被其他材料取代。
infoEn: Mercury, also called quicksilver, is a toxic metal that is liquid at room temperature.
useEn: It was often used in thermometers. Other materials have now replaced many of its uses.

info: 鉈的元素符號是 Tl，原子序數是 81。
infoEn: Thallium has the symbol Tl and atomic number 81.

info: 鉛是密度較大的金屬；鉛及其化合物有毒。
use: 鉛可用於鉛酸電池和輻射屏蔽。
infoEn: Lead is a dense metal. Lead and its compounds are toxic.
useEn: Lead can be used in lead-acid batteries and radiation shielding.

info: 鉍的元素符號是 Bi，原子序數是 83。
infoEn: Bismuth has the symbol Bi and atomic number 83.

info: 釙的元素符號是 Po，原子序數是 84。
infoEn: Polonium has the symbol Po and atomic number 84.

info: 砹的元素符號是 At，原子序數是 85。
infoEn: Astatine has the symbol At and atomic number 85.

info: 氡的元素符號是 Rn，原子序數是 86。
infoEn: Radon has the symbol Rn and atomic number 86.

info: 鍅的元素符號是 Fr，原子序數是 87。
infoEn: Francium has the symbol Fr and atomic number 87.

info: 鐳的元素符號是 Ra，原子序數是 88。
infoEn: Radium has the symbol Ra and atomic number 88.

info: 錒的元素符號是 Ac，原子序數是 89。
infoEn: Actinium has the symbol Ac and atomic number 89.

info: 釷的元素符號是 Th，原子序數是 90。
infoEn: Thorium has the symbol Th and atomic number 90.

info: 鏷的元素符號是 Pa，原子序數是 91。
infoEn: Protactinium has the symbol Pa and atomic number 91.

info: 鈾的元素符號是 U，原子序數是 92。
infoEn: Uranium has the symbol U and atomic number 92.

info: 錼的元素符號是 Np，原子序數是 93。
infoEn: Neptunium has the symbol Np and atomic number 93.

info: 鈽的元素符號是 Pu，原子序數是 94。
infoEn: Plutonium has the symbol Pu and atomic number 94.

info: 鋂的元素符號是 Am，原子序數是 95。
infoEn: Americium has the symbol Am and atomic number 95.

info: 鋦的元素符號是 Cm，原子序數是 96。
infoEn: Curium has the symbol Cm and atomic number 96.

info: 鉳的元素符號是 Bk，原子序數是 97。
infoEn: Berkelium has the symbol Bk and atomic number 97.

info: 鉲的元素符號是 Cf，原子序數是 98。
infoEn: Californium has the symbol Cf and atomic number 98.

info: 鑀的元素符號是 Es，原子序數是 99。
infoEn: Einsteinium has the symbol Es and atomic number 99.

info: 鐨的元素符號是 Fm，原子序數是 100。
infoEn: Fermium has the symbol Fm and atomic number 100.

info: 鍆的元素符號是 Md，原子序數是 101。
infoEn: Mendelevium has the symbol Md and atomic number 101.

info: 鍩的元素符號是 No，原子序數是 102。
infoEn: Nobelium has the symbol No and atomic number 102.

info: 鐒的元素符號是 Lr，原子序數是 103。
infoEn: Lawrencium has the symbol Lr and atomic number 103.

info: 這是由科學家人工合成的放射性元素，主要用於研究。先認識它的名稱、符號和位置。
infoEn: This radioactive element is made artificially by scientists and is mainly used for research. Start by learning its name, symbol and position.
